texts.label: text
texts.orig: Aurora Bank closed 2025 with a net profit of 412 million euros, a rise of nine percent over the previous year. Retail deposits grew steadily while the corporate lending book stayed flat. The board proposes a dividend of 1.80 euros per share and confirms its commitment to a cautious risk policy.
texts.text: Aurora Bank closed 2025 with a net profit of 412 million euros, a rise of nine percent over the previous year. Retail deposits grew steadily while the corporate lending book stayed flat. The board proposes a dividend of 1.80 euros per share and confirms its commitment to a cautious risk policy.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Total revenue reached 1,380 million euros. Net interest income remained the main contributor, followed by fees from asset management and by payment services, which benefited from the growth of contactless transactions across all regions.
texts.text: Total revenue reached 1,380 million euros. Net interest income remained the main contributor, followed by fees from asset management and by payment services, which benefited from the growth of contactless transactions across all regions.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Operating costs increased by only two percent thanks to the consolidation of back-office functions. The cost to income ratio fell to fifty-eight percent, its lowest level in ten years, while investment in cybersecurity doubled compared with 2024.
texts.text: Operating costs increased by only two percent thanks to the consolidation of back-office functions. The cost to income ratio fell to fifty-eight percent, its lowest level in ten years, while investment in cybersecurity doubled compared with 2024.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The bank opened three new branches in the Alsace region during 2025, in Colmar, Mulhouse and Haguenau. Each branch combines a traditional counter with a digital advice area and is staffed by advisers trained in sustainable finance.
texts.text: The bank opened three new branches in the Alsace region during 2025, in Colmar, Mulhouse and Haguenau. Each branch combines a traditional counter with a digital advice area and is staffed by advisers trained in sustainable finance.
